_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. aggroRadius 1.0 is the pre-merge zone radius verbatim and IS the interaction range (D7 ⇒ interaction.range omitted). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Teaches Recall. The zone entry called it 'Wanderer_1'; the suffix was placement bookkeeping, not a name.
name: Wanderer

lines: Don't go east, Bandits are watching the road. Better try the tunnel up north.

options.blockedLine: Are you sure you should be out here? Anyways, don't go further east.

grants.line: Always nice to return to a fire!
